This Is What You Came For è un brano musicale pubblicato dal disc jockey britannico Calvin Harris con la collaborazione della cantante barbadiana Rihanna. Il brano è stato pubblicato come singolo il 29 aprile 2016 per il download digitale. Il singolo segna il terzo sforzo musicale tra i due artisti, essi infatti avevano precedentemente collaborato in We Found Love (2011) e Where Have You Been (2012), estratti dall'album Talk That Talk di Rihanna.

Etichetta discografica: Westbury Road, Sony Music
Produttore: Calvin Harris


This Is What You Came For is a song published by the British disc jockey Calvin Harris collaboration with the Barbadian singer Rihanna. The song was released as a single April 29, 2016 for digital download. The single marks the third musical effort between the two artists, for they had previously collaborated on We Found Love (2011) and Where Have You Been (2012), from the album Talk That Talk by Rihanna.

Record label: Westbury Road, Sony Music
Producer: Calvin Harris
